entities.summary: Albert Sacco Jr. is an American chemical engineer who flew as a Payload Specialist on the Space Shuttle Columbia on Shuttle mission STS-73 in 1995. He currently serves as the Provost and Dean of the Franklin W. Olin College of Engineering.
